name: NBHD Friends Tools
description: Backstage Neighborhood tools: propose a lesson share to a neighbor (proposal only, human-approved) and read neighbors' scrubbed shared sparks. No direct-post tool by design.

apiBaseUrl.description: Override NBHD API base URL. Defaults to NBHD_API_BASE_URL env var.

requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for NBHD runtime endpoint requests.

proposeEnabled.description: Register the two PROPOSE tools (nbhd_propose_lesson_share, nbhd_propose_mission_task). The runtime endpoints 403 independently; this is the don't-even-offer-it layer.
